name: Pi Zero 2W + SSD1683 4.2" EPD Bonnet Demo
description: Drives an Adafruit 4.2" 400x300 SSD1683 EPD (PID 6381) sat on the Pi e-Ink Bonnet, on a Pi Zero 2W running the host build. Pin map matches Blinka's BCM-keyed Dxx aliases (CS=CE0/D8, DC=D22, RST=D27, BUSY=D17). The host driver pins `seconds_per_frame=5` on the upstream lib (vs the 180 s default), so script delays only need to cover the actual refresh time plus a moment for a human to read each frame.

steps.name: checkin-response
steps.description: Respond to device checkin with OK and Pi-bonnet-shaped capabilities (display added separately so it shows up in the controller flow).

steps.name: add-display
steps.description: Add the SSD1683 4.2" 400x300 EPD over SPI bus 0 with the bonnet's fixed bonnet pin map. Initial blank refresh runs as part of Add.

steps.name: write-hello
steps.description: First message after the initial blank refresh.

steps.name: write-step2
steps.description: Second message — driver's seconds_per_frame is 5 s, this gives a beat to read.

steps.name: write-removing
steps.description: Final message before the display is removed.

steps.name: remove-display
steps.description: Tear down the display so a future Add can re-init the bus cleanly.
